newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SIEMENS TO SUPPLY ATMS TO HUNGARY'S HYPO-BANK.
newsitem.headline: SIEMENS TO SUPPLY ATMS TO HUNGARY'S HYPO-BANK.

text.p: Hungary's Hypo-Bank Hungaria Rt said on Wednesday it had signed a long-term agreement with Siemens Nixdorf under which the German computer firm will supply 20 Automated Teller Machines (ATMs) to the bank in three years.
As a first step, Siemens Nixdorf installed two ATMs at Hypo-Bank's Budapest headquarters and at its recently opened branch in Gyor, western Hungary, the bank said in a statement.
The deal is for the delivery of 20 ATMs but the number of machines may double if demand justifies that, it added.
Hypo-Bank Hungaria Rt, wholly-owned Hungarian subsidiary of Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel Bank AG , joined bank payment services company, Europay International in 1994.
